description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d_tracer/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc_tracer driven by problems/heat_column_varcoeff_forced_tracer.md (two tracers, NTRACER=2 bound at the import edge; shared variable interface coefficient K = 1 + z; per-tracer manufactured forcing; per-tracer prescribed K du/dz that differs between the two faces and between the tracers). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API NLEV binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Nothing is discretely exact, so the recorded (relative) L2 errors at t=0.1 are the full spatial error of the per-tracer interface-coefficient flux-difference stencil on the stretched column, expected to fall as O(dz^2) like tests/conformance/convergence/heat_column_varcoeff_forced's.
